**Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815)**  
*Estimated total casualties:* **≈ 25 000–30 000**

| Side | Approximate killed & wounded |
|------|------------------------------|
| French army (under Napoleon) | ~12 500 – 15 000 |
| Allied forces (British‑Dutch‑German coalition under Wellington) | ~10 000 – 11 000 |

These figures include both dead and wounded soldiers on each side. Exact counts vary among contemporary reports and modern historians due to differences in record‑keeping and battlefield conditions. For more detailed breakdowns you may consult primary military dispatches or reputable secondary histories such as *“Napoleon’s Last Campaign”* by John R. Hale or *“Waterloo: A New History”* by Andrew Roberts.
